column1: # Rung 1 (relational equivalence) on the fire-sale bank with Chapter 1's stale y
# (2026-10-22). Supersedes rung1_relational.tsv (vault bank, shock signal; F8 showed
# a signal of the shock cannot pass). DRAFT until (1) the calibration pilot
# (calib_d_scan.tsv) sets r and d (placeholders: p3's r 0.05, d 0.6) and (2) the
# pre-registration (docs/rung1_prereg.md) is signed off.
# Every arm: fire-sale bank, theta ~ U[0,1], private signal x_i = theta + 0.10 Z,
# e 0.06, R(theta) = 1.0 + 0.4 theta, R_stay 1.1, attributed public noise s_y 0.10,
# one lambda for both blends (LAMBDA_SCOPE=both) unless the tag says otherwise.
# Grid reference: 5 mu x 3 lambda pairs = 15 cells; sigma 2.5 (Celsius, F7).
# BANKRUN_SEEDING=common, N_INIT=25 and the same seed offset (1000) in every arm:
# all 150 cells run the same 25 banks x 10 runs with the same theta and shocks,
# so every contrast below is run for run.
#   none            private signal only (the G1'/G4' base)
#   stale-y20/50/80 y fixed at y0; theta < y0 is optimistic (G1), theta > y0
#                   pessimistic (G4); y0 is G2's reassurance comparative static
#   tracks-g0       y = theta: signals agree (G3's reference)
#   tracks-g20      y = theta + 0.2: Chapter 1's declined constant markup
#   corrects-y80-r50 gap decays by half each tick: Table 1.x's "error corrects"
#   stale-y80-count / -theta  lambda in one blend only (the other at mean lambda):
#                   which channel carries the sorting
#   stale-y50-s1    sigma 1, no whales: the mechanism without the liquidity floor
# Read: python3 scripts/rung1_relational.py outputs/r1t-stale-* outputs/r1t-corrects-* \
#         outputs/r1t-tracks-g20 --base outputs/r1t-none --agree outputs/r1t-tracks-g0
